_comment: Postcard settings for this scenario (scripts/postcard.py, docs/postcard.md). items: the small pictures shown beside the text; beats: which item each scene (beat) shows. An item is {"file": an existing picture}, {"combine": [{"file", "half": "left"|"right"}, ...]} (halves side by side, made by scripts/postcard_items.py), {"prompt": ...} (drawn once by scripts/postcard_items.py), or {"trail": [item, ...]} (those items as footprints in a winding line down the card's right edge, taking turns; count, wiggle_mm). anchor (top_right / top_left / bottom_right / bottom_left) and size_mm place a single item; placement gives the defaults.
